claude.sample_unit: patients (86 head and neck, 50 cervical cancer)

links.outcome: Ability of automated two-contour QA (geometric vs geometric plus dose metrics) to flag dosimetric errors in auto-contours
links.effect: Adding dose metrics raised ROC-AUC and PR-AUC for Dmean error in H&N small structures. For Dmax error, it improved H&N small, H&N medium and GYN structures.
links.quote: In many instances, utilizing dose with geometric comparisons can improve the ability of a verification model to flag potential errors from a primary auto-contouring model.

unlisted_practices: Using a second independent auto-contouring model as a verification check on the primary model
Adding dosimetric comparison metrics to geometric comparison in automated contour QA
